item.title: ‘Country’ Joe McDonald, ’60s rock star, proud protest counterculture icon, dies at 84
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — “Country” Joe McDonald, a hippie rock star of the 1960s whose “I-Feel-Like-I’m-Fixin’-To-Die Rag” was a four-lettered rebuke to the Vietnam War that became an anthem for protesters and a highlight of the Woodstock music festival, died Sunday. item.title: Crude oil prices surpass $100 a barrel as the Iran war impedes production and shipping
item.description: CHICAGO (AP) — Oil prices have eclipsed $100 per barrel for the first time in more than three and a half years as the Iran war hinders production and shipping in the Middle East. item.title: Japan’s Nikkei 225 share index falls more than 6% as oil soars over $100 a barrel
item.description: BANGKOK (AP) — Japan’s benchmark Nikkei 225 index plunged more than 6% early Monday after oil prices soared to over $100 a barrel due to supply disruptions from the war in the Middle East.
